title: Highly Motivated Awakener (F4M (Awakener))
description: It's time to let go of the fantasy, sweetie. To open your eyes out of the happy hazy headspace of trance, as I count you back up to reality. Choosing this file while you're still in a nice state of euphoric bliss. A feeling which I want you to keep: for as long as feels good, as long as you are free from responsibility. Because after you listen to my suggestions here, high is how I wish for you to feel. To have a head pleasantly slowed of thought. But with the drive to be productive and get things done once this blissful high fades.
author: Mistress Shibby
